snippet.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Fever - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Jigsaw Puzzle Fever is a single player game that is fun for all the family. Pick one of the ten starting puzzles to get on your way.

The pieces are laid out on the screen - the player simply scrolls through the available pieces and selects a piece.

Puzzles are grouped into levels. Once all of the initial 10 puzzles have been completed, the next level unlocks. There are 75 puzzles in total.

Jigsaw Puzzle Fever (C) Funbox Media
Developed by Nyx Digital
Also released on Nintendo Switch and PC
